newsitem.title: USA: Number Nine launches reseller program.
newsitem.headline: Number Nine launches reseller program.

text.p: Number Nine Visual Technology Corp launched a program intended to strengthen its value-added reseller (VAR) channel and to increase awareness of its products.

Number Nine's new PowerBroker program targets VARs that design and build reliable, high-performance computers systems for the CAD/CAM/CAE, desktop publishing, document imaging, video, medical, and scientific markets, as well as broad-based business and graphic applications.

Number Nine will provide qualified PowerBroker VARs with a number of services targeted at increasing both product and company awareness such as: pre- and post-sales support via dedicated Number Nine VAR Channel Development Managers, toll-free technical support, special purchase opportunities, end- user lead referrals, on-site training, co-operative advertising, mailers and other sales generating tools.

Additionally, the PowerBroker program will offer exclusive access to an enhanced VAR section of Number Nine's Internet Web site (http://www.nine.com/PowerBroker), previews of new products and promotions, early access to new products and upgrades, regular VAR update kits and early notification of special promotions.
